! JO9 MOD START BUYER_RUMORS_SCAN | 2026-10-24_buyer_rumors
local $jo9_rs_provider = $args[0]
local $jo9_rs_role, jo9_rs_i, jo9_rs_b, jo9_rs_rank, jo9_rs_best, jo9_rs_ties, $jo9_rs_names, $jo9_rs_actor, $jo9_rs_sentence

gs 'jo9_rumor_roster', $jo9_rs_provider
local slave_specialisation, slave_obedience_bonus, slaveprice, haggling_limit, relative_rating, rating, $rating_help, is_stock
local slave_mood_bonus, slave_nature, slave_fear_bonus, slave_obedience_penalty, attribute_sum, max_skill, max_sex, skill_sum, maxsum, slave_base_price

! Nested trait helpers explicitly erase their scratch variables, so preserve exact arrays.
copyarr '$jo9_rumor_saved_mode', '$jo9_trait_value_mode'
copyarr '$jo9_rumor_saved_actor', '$jo9_trait_value_actor'
copyarr 'jo9_rumor_saved_amount', 'jo9_trait_value_amount'
copyarr 'jo9_rumor_saved_peerless', 'jo9_trait_value_saved_peerless'
copyarr 'jo9_rumor_saved_rate', 'jo9_trait_value_rate'
copyarr 'jo9_rumor_saved_grade', 'jo9_trait_value_grade'
if snk_room_target > 0: jump 'jo9_rs_cleanup'
for jo9_rs_i = 0 to arrsize('$all_slave_characters') - 1:
 $jo9_rs_role = $all_slave_characters[jo9_rs_i]
 killvar 'jo9_rumor_probe'
 killvar '$jo9_rumor_probe'
 killvar 'jo9_rumor_probe_rate'
 copyarr 'jo9_rumor_probe', $jo9_rs_role
 copyarr '$jo9_rumor_probe', '$' + $jo9_rs_role
 copyarr 'jo9_rumor_probe_rate', $jo9_rs_role + '_rate'
 dynamic 'jo9_rumor_probe_state = <<$jo9_rs_role>>_state & jo9_rumor_probe_type = <<$jo9_rs_role>>_type & $jo9_rumor_probe_psy_status = $<<$jo9_rs_role>>_psy_status & $jo9_rumor_probe_name = $<<$jo9_rs_role>>_name'
 if jo9_rumor_probe_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist'] or jo9_rumor_probe_state = CONST_INT['slave_faint']:
  if jo9_rumor_probe['brand'] ! 4:
   jo9_rumor_actor_count += 1
   gs 'jo9_traits_value', 'refresh', 'jo9_rumor_probe'
   dynamic $replace($update_slave_price, 'dyn'+'slave', 'jo9_rumor_probe')
   jo9_rumor_rating = rating
   jo9_rumor_charm = charm
   copyarr 'jo9_rumor_spec', 'slave_specialisation'
   jo9_rs_best = -1
   killvar '$jo9_rs_hits'
   if jo9_rumor_probe['brand'] > 0 and jo9_rumor_probe_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist']:
    for jo9_rs_b = 0 to arrsize('$jo9_rumor_buyer') - 1:
     if func('jo9_rumor_roster', 'available', $jo9_rumor_buyer[jo9_rs_b]) = 1:
      if func('jo9_rumor_match', $jo9_rumor_buyer[jo9_rs_b], $jo9_rumor_mode[jo9_rs_b], jo9_rumor_nocharm[jo9_rs_b]) = 1:
       jo9_rs_rank = demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_buyer[jo9_rs_b]]
       if jo9_rs_rank > jo9_rs_best:
        killvar '$jo9_rs_hits'
        jo9_rs_best = jo9_rs_rank
       end
       if jo9_rs_rank = jo9_rs_best: $jo9_rs_hits[arrsize('$jo9_rs_hits')] = $jo9_rumor_buyer[jo9_rs_b]
      end
     end
    end
   end
   $jo9_rs_actor = replace(replace(replace($jo9_rumor_probe_name, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')
   if $jo9_rs_actor = '': $jo9_rs_actor = '이 인물'
   if arrsize('$jo9_rs_hits') = 0:
    $jo9_rs_sentence = '<<$jo9_rs_actor>>에게는 지금 이 지역에서 권할 만한 고정 구매처가 떠오르지 않는군. 몸 상태나 낙인, 교육 정도를 다시 살펴보게.'
    $jo9_rumor_pages[arrsize('$jo9_rumor_pages')] = $jo9_rs_sentence
   else
    $jo9_rs_names = ''
    jo9_rs_ties = 0
    for jo9_rs_b = 0 to arrsize('$jo9_rs_hits') - 1:
     if jo9_rs_ties > 0: $jo9_rs_names += ', '
     $jo9_rs_names += $npc_name[$jo9_rs_hits[jo9_rs_b]]
     jo9_rs_ties += 1
     if jo9_rs_ties = 3 or jo9_rs_b = arrsize('$jo9_rs_hits') - 1:
      $jo9_rumor_pages[arrsize('$jo9_rumor_pages')] = '내가 듣기로는 <<$jo9_rs_names>> 쪽에서 찾는 조건과 <<$jo9_rs_actor>>의 상태가 잘 맞는군. 이 근방에서도 눈여겨볼 만한 상대들이지. 직접 찾아가 이야기를 들어 보게.'
      jo9_rs_ties = 0
      $jo9_rs_names = ''
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

! JO9 MOD START RUMOR_MATCH_PURE | 2026-10-24_buyer_rumors
! Inputs: buyer id, simple or house or full mode, no charm flag.
! Probe arrays and appraised rating, charm, spec are prepared by the caller.
! This matcher reads those inputs and returns only numeric result.
! Native metadata writes only isolated temporary requirement arrays.
local $jo9_rumor_match_buyer = $args[0]
local $jo9_rumor_match_mode = $args[1]
local jo9_rumor_match_no_charm = args[2]
local jo9_rumor_match_charm_min = 6
local jo9_rumor_match_lock = 0
local $jo9_rumor_match_code = ''
result = 0
killvar 'jo9_rumor_match_demand'
killvar '$jo9_rumor_match_demand'
killvar 'jo9_rumor_match_importance'
killvar '$jo9_rumor_match_importance'
if $jo9_rumor_match_buyer = '': jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if $jo9_rumor_match_mode ! 'simple' and $jo9_rumor_match_mode ! 'house' and $jo9_rumor_match_mode ! 'full': jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if jo9_rumor_probe_state <= CONST_INT['no_slave']: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if jo9_rumor_rating < demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer]: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'

if demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer] >= 3: jo9_rumor_match_charm_min = 12
if demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer] >= 5: jo9_rumor_match_charm_min = 18
if demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer] >= 7: jo9_rumor_match_charm_min = 24
if demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer] >= 9: jo9_rumor_match_charm_min = 38
jo9_rumor_match_lock = jo9_rumor_probe[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer]
if jo9_rumor_match_lock > 0 and day - jo9_rumor_match_lock >= 10: jo9_rumor_match_lock = 0

! Native simple and house entry checks consume no metadata.
! An expired lock is treated as cleared without changing the probe.
if $jo9_rumor_match_mode = 'simple' or $jo9_rumor_match_mode = 'house':
 if jo9_rumor_match_lock ! 0: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
 if $jo9_rumor_match_mode = 'simple':
  if jo9_rumor_spec[$interesting_specialisation[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer]] < demand_rating[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer] / 2: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
 end
 if jo9_rumor_charm < jo9_rumor_match_charm_min and jo9_rumor_match_no_charm = 0: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
end
if jo9_rumor_probe['wounds'] > 0 or jo9_rumor_probe['energy'] < 0 or jo9_rumor_probe['stamina'] < 2: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if jo9_rumor_probe['rehabilitation'] > 0 or $jo9_rumor_probe_psy_status = 'broken': jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if jo9_rumor_probe['pregnant'] > 0 and jo9_rumor_probe['pregnant_revealed'] > 0: jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'
if $jo9_rumor_match_mode = 'simple': result = 1 & jump 'jo9_rumor_match_done'

! Full matches native slave_sell_chek. House also requires its entry checks.
! Full does not add an active lock refusal absent from the native checker.
jo9_rumor_match_demand['refuse_age'] = 99
jo9_rumor_match_demand['max_exotic'] = 99
jo9_rumor_match_demand['max_fat'] = 99
jo9_rumor_match_demand['min_fat'] = 1
$jo9_rumor_match_code = replace($buyer_demand[$jo9_rumor_match_buyer], 'demand[', 'jo9_rumor_match_demand[')
dynamic $jo9_rumor_match_code
